products.name: Great Encounters Booster Box
products.note: 36 packs. TCGplayer lists the box without a market price, so it is priced at 36 packs.

products.name: 2008 Spring Collector's Tin [Dialga LV.X]
products.note: Four Diamond & Pearl-series packs in the real tin (Mysterious Treasures, Secret Wonders and Great Encounters; Bulbapedia's merchandise page excerpt and Collector's Cache listings; the split is not documented, so it opens here as Great Encounters packs). Tin not simulated.
